# Delivery Requirements Checklist: Stable Planning Roadmap MVP

**Purpose**: Review whether the written requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable across planner safety, evidence capture, and laptop mobile demo
**Created**: 2026-10-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five hard-gate families defined, including the detailed checks each family must expose? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the conditions for returning fewer than five alternatives exhaustively specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are acceptance-record contents sufficient for future audit, comparison learning, and data-version tracing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Are live, stale, and seeded mobile states each defined with allowed and prohibited claims? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Mobile Contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is “complete alternative” unambiguous enough to determine whether a plan qualifies for display? [Clarity, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK006 Is shadow non-authority stated consistently for planning, ordering, feasibility, and selection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, FR-007, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the 150, 40, 50, and 200 evidence thresholds associated with distinct later capabilities without overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019–FR-021]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the desktop phone-frame behavior quantified for both mobile and desktop viewport classes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the API contract and feature spec agree that five alternatives are a target rather than permission to return infeasible padding? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract §POST /itinerary]
- [ ] CHK010 Do backward-compatible selection and durable idempotent selection have clearly different guarantees? [Consistency, Contract §POST /itinerary/select]
- [ ] CHK011 Are local-map, online-routing, geolocation, and interpolated-route states consistent between the spec and mobile contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, Mobile Contract §Map]
- [ ] CHK012 Do offline demo requirements avoid conflicting with immutable server acceptance requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, FR-025]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can every alternative-safety outcome be measured using the same request and data version? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Is duplicate identity measurable by an explicitly defined ordered POI-set rule? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is idempotency success objectively defined as one row and one stable acceptance identifier? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are mobile overflow and end-to-end demo timing criteria objectively measurable at the named viewports? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are zero-feasible-plan and candidate-shortage behaviors specified without presenting a partial plan as complete? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are judge timeout, malformed output, unknown candidate, order disagreement, and insufficient-metric-sample scenarios all covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are selection-cache loss, database unavailability, old schema, and retry recovery requirements defined? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are API-unavailable, routing-unavailable, geolocation-denied, and map-only demo scenarios defined separately? [Coverage, Spec §US4, Edge Cases]

## Dependencies, Security, and Scope

- [ ] CHK021 Is the no-new-dependency constraint consistent with every planned backend and Flutter capability? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK022 Are runtime database files, API URLs, and provider keys clearly separated from committed source/configuration? [Security, Spec §FR-028, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK023 Are root map/search/route/play-pause regressions explicitly retained while Flutter becomes the primary frontend? [Scope, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK024 Are learned-weight promotion, full-day learning, and accepted-day retrieval explicitly excluded from implementation until their evidence gates are met? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope, FR-019–FR-021]

## Notes

- Depth: formal PR/release requirement-quality gate.
- Audience/timing: peer reviewer before implementation is allowed to proceed.
- Focus: feasibility authority, accepted-plan evidence, bias-calibrated shadow ranking, mobile/offline honesty, and regression boundaries.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
